line: Every video editor squeezes the picture to fit the audio. We build it backwards, on purpose.
This script doesn't stretch the voice to fit the video — the cuts move to match the voice's real pauses instead.
The old way stretched every line to fit one set size. A line that ran long still spilled into the next.
One real episode went out with two lines talking at once.
Now every timing, captions, cuts, on-screen beats, moves through the narration's own measured gaps.
One more real bug — an episode once cut off mid-word, because the tool's guess landed early.
Now the actual audio file is the floor. The picture can't end before the voice does.
This isn't special software. Anyone can do this by hand, in any program. Find the real pause in the voice, and cut there.
The setup's in the link in bio.
Follow for the setup that actually works.
